name: Vita marie gold
ingredients_raw: REFINED WHEAT FLOUR (MAIDA) (66%), SUGAR, REFINED PALM OIL, MILK PRODUCTS [MILK SOLIDS & SWEETENED CONDENSED PARTLY SKIMMED MILK], INVERT SUGAR SYRUP, RAISING AGENTS [503(ii) & 500(ii)], IODISED SALT, EMULSIFIERS [471 & 322(i)], ARTIFICIAL (MILK, BUTTER & VANILLA) FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, VITAMINS, DOUGH CONDITIONER (223), MINERALS# AND IMPROVER [1101(i)]. CONTAINS WHEAT, MILK, SOYA AND SULPHITE.
